final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT healtheval, site_count, 1.0 * site_count / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.site_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.value) SELECT AVG(site_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess_share FROM above_avg
